testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect panel visibility from a minimized ribbon tab: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-visibility-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:313:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect panel visibility from a minimized ribbon tab ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active ✔ And the top-docked ribbon is minimized to tabs with 3D Model active ✔ And the Modify panel is visible and Parameters is hidden ✔ When the user right-clicks the 3D Model tab ✔ Then the ribbon context menu opens ✔ When the user opens Show Panels ✔ Then the submenu lists the 3D Model panels ✔ And Modify is checked and Parameters is unchecked ✔ And the ribbon remains minimized to tabs ✔ When the user clicks an empty area of the viewport ✔ Then both menus close ✔ And the ribbon remains minimized to tabs
